column1: # FROZEN SNAPSHOT — DO NOT EDIT BY HAND, DO NOT REGENERATE.
# Every NOT NULL column in the live `greenput` database, observed 2026-09-11.
# The companion to 000-baseline-columns.tsv. That file catches a column schema.sql
# declares that no migration can create. This one catches a column that exists on both
# sides but disagrees about whether NULL is allowed — which is not a cosmetic
# difference: schema.sql declared `users.password_hash TEXT` (nullable) for passwordless
# signup while the live table declared it NOT NULL, so every attempt to create an
#   D1_ERROR: NOT NULL constraint failed: users.password_hash
# A fresh database worked. The real one rejected every signup.
# SQLite cannot ALTER a column's nullability, so a mismatch is resolved either by
# changing what the code writes or by rebuilding the table — never by editing this file.
# Regenerating it from a newer database would absorb the very drift it exists to catch.
